mapping_caveats: Fairfax County Public Schools (div 029) serves Fairfax County (51059) and, by contract, Fairfax City (51600) students; Fairfax City has its own FIPS but no separately operated school system in the Title I/FRL lists (general knowledge, not verified this session).
Falls Church City (51610) has its own division (109); Manassas (51683) div 143; Manassas Park (51685) div 144; Alexandria (51510) div 101.
ACS county values are residence-based; school F/R counts are enrollment-based. Do not mix numerators/denominators across them.
The town of Herndon/Vienna etc. are inside Fairfax County, not separate FIPS.

osm.usage_policy: Per wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Overpass_API: <10,000 queries/day and <1 GB/day is safe; for regular use divide by 100; send identifying User-Agent/Referer; no parallel scripts; commercial use should self-host; back off 30 s after 429/406.
